name: Underwood Family Farms Moorpark (Tierra Rejada)
tagline: Pick Your Own – Underwood Family Farms
description: Underwood Family Farms Moorpark (Tierra Rejada) is a u-pick farm in Moorpark, CA. Visitors come for Strawberries and Tomatoes, best in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
